native_mechanisms: A single rolling sphere is the only carried memory across the whole ordered pile (one accumulator register, no side state).
Each mark is pressed into the sphere and then tumbled a fixed, data-independent count of turns (strike stalk / crack / read angle) before the next mark is taken.
Only the final hairline crack from the last stalk is handed over as the token; all intermediate cracks, faces and dust are discarded.
core_technique: FNV-1a/xxHash-style streaming hash: one 64-bit accumulator, per byte xor-in then a fixed number of multiply-by-odd-constant / xor-shift-32 / rotate-27 mixing rounds, plus a length-mixing finalization returning the last xor-shift value.
